hook.text: Uber drivers also drive for Lyft. Sellers list on Amazon and eBay. Users often use both rivals.

buildup.text: Multi-homing is when users participate on multiple competing platforms simultaneously.

discovery.text: When multi-homing is easy, platforms can't build loyalty or charge high fees. Competition stays fierce.

twist.text: Platforms fight multi-homing with exclusivity deals. Spotify pays for podcast exclusives to keep you there.

climax.text: The ease of multi-homing determines whether a market becomes a monopoly or stays competitive.

punchline.text: If users can easily use both, neither platform wins outright.
